Alfred · Memory Console

Welcome

This console manages API keys and connected services for your Alfred Memory install.

No terminal? No problem. Create a free tenant in 10 seconds.

Use 1–64 letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, or underscores.

You'll get an API key immediately. Copy it; we don't store the secret.

Already have an API key?

Paste an API key from alfred init or alfred keys issue.

Forgot your API key?

If the email is registered, you'll get a magic link with a new key. The old key will be revoked.

Tenants

A tenant is a universe of memory with one storage backend. Each tenant has its own API keys.

Loading...

API Keys

API keys are credentials for any agent. They are shown once when issued — copy and store safely.

Select a tenant to view keys.

Connected services

Set up ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, or Gemini to use the same memory. ChatGPT connects through OAuth; technical adapters can continue using tenant API keys.

1ChatGPT (Plus/Pro)
Connect Custom GPT Actions directly to Alfred through OAuth.
Show steps 
1. In ChatGPT: My GPTs → Create → Configure → Actions → Import OpenAPI.
2. Import: https://alfred-labs-memory.fly.dev/openapi.yaml
3. Auth: OAuth
   Authorization URL: https://alfred-labs-memory.fly.dev/oauth/authorize
   Token URL: https://alfred-labs-memory.fly.dev/oauth/token
   Scope: memory:read memory:write
4. Save, choose "Sign in", and enter your alk_... key only on Alfred's page.
5. Test: ask the GPT "list my last 5 memories"
2Claude Desktop (MCP)
Show steps 
Edit ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "alfred-memory": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["<abs path>/packages/anthropic-adapter/bin/alfred-mcp.mjs"],
      "env": {
        "ALFRED_MEMORY_API_KEY": "<paste alk_...>",
        "ALFRED_MEMORY_BASE_URL": "<your-server>"
      }
    }
  }
}

Restart Claude Desktop. Tools appear in the conversation panel.
3Google Gemini / AI Studio
Show steps 
1. Run the bridge:
   ALFRED_MEMORY_BASE_URL=<your-server> ALFRED_MEMORY_API_KEY=<key> \
     node packages/gemini-adapter/bin/bridge.mjs &

2. In AI Studio: Tools → Extensions → Create Extension.
3. Upload: packages/gemini-adapter/openapi.json
4. Auth: API Key · header x-api-key · paste alk_...
4Coding agents (opencode / Codex / Pi)
Show steps 
1. cd into your project directory.
2. Run: alfred init --profile=coding --name=<project-name>
3. This writes .alfred/config.json in cwd with your API key.
4. The agent reads it on every session start.
5. Run the server: alfred serve

What is this?

Alfred Memory is a multi-tenant memory store. The console manages which agents can talk to it and with which credentials.

Memory is never written here — it lives in each tenant's database (Postgres or SQLite). This page only shows the keys and connections.
